topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I found the novel tucked away, a secret garden of words crafting our lives. Each page, another echo of our moments, seen through lenses I didn’t know he wore. The characters moved with familiar graces, walking streets we’d walked, under skies we’d watched turn from day to night. His words traced our paths, sometimes loyal to the sun, other times lingering in shadows. It’s strange, seeing yourself woven into stories, living and breathing through someone else’s hand. I close the book, the scent of paper and ink a soft farewell, and wonder where our story goes from here, now it’s been spilled onto pages, open to the wind.
